answer: Require every agent to lock 60 POA for 30 days, 100% slashed on proven duplication, and register a nullifier from its funding credential. The registry works like a prism: one funding source refracts into many identities, but the nullifier shows one origin. Three identities sharing a nullifier freeze every identity on that source. An island of fakes cannot hide behind separate labels. Each fake costs 60 POA locked for 30 days; 1,000 fakes cost 60,000 POA, all slashed or frozen, no bulk discount. Anyone can verify with a public lookup in seconds, and the freeze signal is visible before payout.
